transformations: Explicit Figma temporary asset literals become local hashed URLs.
Unreferenced Figma layer id annotations become data-figma-layer so repeated components do not duplicate DOM IDs; referenced IDs require an explicit useId adaptation.
Figma font family style descriptors become the actual family plus their declared weight and style.
Tailwind compiles internally; preflight, theme and utility selectors are scoped under .aurora-library.
scope: Only entries listed below are implemented or rendered. Build success is not visual, accessibility, or behavior certification.

additionalExports.scope: Additional source-backed exports; Figma node coverage is recorded separately.

nativeEntry.scope: Native controls and source-backed surfaces, including four approved Aurora background vector scenes; no product-screen scenes or archive raster asset resolver modules.
